entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Elven guildmaster of the Simic Combine who pursued artificial enhancement and was killed by Agrus Kos.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Killed Momir Vig while inhabiting Savra's body.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: Took possession of Savra's body and allied with Vig.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: Whose body was inhabited by Svogthir and Kos.

entities.name: Project Kraj
entities.description: Plan to cleanse and remake Ravnica.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: Hatched dragons whose cerebral fluid was used in a serum.

entities.name: Cytoplasts
entities.description: Semi-organic globules that transfer genetic traits.

events.summary: Momir Vig becomes guildmaster of the Simic Combine and seeks to enhance life through experimentation.
events.quote: Momir Vig became the guildmaster of the Simic Combine in Cizarm of 9211 ZC.

events.summary: Vig develops cytoplasts to store and transfer beneficial traits.
Vig engineers a cytoplast that bonds by contact, bypassing consent.
events.quote: Vig engineered a new variant of cytoplast that could bond with a host through simple contact

events.summary: Vig allies with Svogthir and they initiate Project Kraj.
Agrus Kos kills Vig by stabbing him in the eye.
events.quote: slew Vig by stabbing him in the eye

events.summary: Project Kraj battles the demon Rakdos and both are defeated.
events.quote: Project Kraj went on to battle the demon Rakdos , resulting in both entities being defeated.

relations.quote: Momir Vig was the elven guild leader of the Simic Combine on Ravnica .
Vig was killed by Agrus Kos during the events of Ravnica block .
